entities.name: Failed Colonization Attempts
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The English attempted settlements in 1605 (67 survivors from a ship blown off course) and 1638, but Kalinago attacks destroyed both colonies within months. The French also made early attempts with similar results, establishing Saint Lucia's reputation as a difficult island to colonize.
